feeds.title: Cal Newport's Study Hacks Blog
feeds.description: Cal Newport is an Associate Professor of Computer Science at Georgetown University, who specializes in the theory of distributed algorithms. He previously earned his PhD. from MIT in 2009. He writes about how to perform productive, valuable, and meaningful work in an increasingly distracted digital age. He focuses on deep work, success, productivity, and work-life balance.
